A Gold Shop Inside a Mall — Why That Matters

Selling gold means carrying something valuable through public space and discussing money at a counter. Where the shop sits changes how safe that feels. Our store is inside Gaur City Centre — a busy, well-lit commercial complex with security, footfall and parking — not an isolated street shop. You can combine your visit with everyday errands, family members can wait comfortably nearby, and the transaction itself happens at a proper counter with digital KYC and an invoice. Many of our women customers and senior citizens tell us this setting is a big reason they chose us; we have written more about it on our safe place to sell gold page.

What Happens at the Counter

Bring your gold, silver, diamond jewellery or coins, plus one photo ID. Your items are XRF-tested in front of you — purity on screen, zero damage — then weighed on a certified scale and valued at the day's live market rate with the calculation explained. Accept, and payment is made instantly by cash, NEFT or RTGS with an invoice; decline, and you take your items back — testing is free either way. From walk-in to walk-out usually takes 10–15 minutes. If your gold is pledged against a loan, bring the loan receipt too — releasing pledged gold is handled at the same counter.

Reaching the Shop

Gaur Chowk is the best-known crossing in Greater Noida West, so autos and cabs find the complex easily. Gaur City 1 and 2 residents are 2–10 minutes away; Noida Extension and Bisrakh about 5–12 minutes; Crossing Republik 12–20 minutes via Shahberi; Noida sectors 119–122 about 10–18 minutes. Use the Get Directions button above for live routing to our exact pin.

How It Works

Sell in 4 Steps, 10–15 Minutes

1

Walk Into Our Store

Visit us at Shop No. GF-04, Gaur City Centre, Gaur Chowk, Sector 4, Greater Noida West with your jewellery and one valid photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport or Driving Licence).

2

Free XRF Testing

Your gold's purity is tested live on a German XRF Karatmeter. The result appears on screen in front of you — 100% transparent, zero damage.

3

Clear Valuation

We weigh your item in front of you and calculate the value from the live market rate and tested purity. Every number is explained — no hidden deductions.

4

Instant Payment

Accept the offer and get paid immediately by cash, NEFT or RTGS, with a proper invoice. The full process takes about 10–15 minutes.
